instruction: Ensure that when my terminal opens, it defaults to 80 columns wide and 24 rows high.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.write('stty size'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.press('enter')

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting terminal default window size to 80x24 (standard classic terminal dimensions). Evaluator opens a new terminal and checks that 'stty size' outputs '24 80' (rows columns). Uses existing check_include_exclude metric and get_vm_terminal_output getter. This is a similar OS configuration task to the original, just with different dimension values.
